**Why**
A source, a specification reference, or a reproducible demonstration. Corrections to the
cryptography are the most valuable contributions to this project, so please include enough for
someone else to verify it independently.

**Is it wrong, or only imprecise?**
Both are worth reporting — say which, since the fix differs. A simplification that becomes false
matters more than one that is merely incomplete.
